name: smitline
description: Phone calls and Zoom, Teams and Google Meet meetings for any AI agent. Self-hosted.
long_description: Smitline lets your agent place phone calls and join Zoom, Teams and Google Meet meetings. It says it is an AI, talks in real time with GPT-Live, and returns a structured result: the outcome, decisions, action items and the transcript. Smitline runs on your computer in Docker with your own OpenAI and phone-provider keys; this bundle connects your MCP client to it. Set it up first: https://github.com/kaelorlabs/smitline#readme
